title: kate-search: list the hits a find bar paints
summary: highlights returns every non-empty hit for the find bar. An empty pattern returns an empty list. The GPUI bar stays out of this packet. The test goes in the existing bar tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: bar.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add highlights on impl FindBar. Keep it public. An empty pattern returns Ok of an empty Vec. Otherwise call find_all with query and keep the hits whose range is not empty. Use is_empty on the range. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch hit_count, find_from, replace_one, or replace_all. The existing test hit_count_skips_an_empty_pattern stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test highlights_lists_non_empty_hits uses sample of pattern a, an empty replacement, FindMode::Plain, and backwards false on the text a b a. highlights returns two hits. The first range starts at Offset(0). The second range starts at Offset(4). An empty pattern on that buffer returns an empty Vec. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: bar::tests::highlights_lists_non_empty_hits
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because highlights does not exist. After the change the pattern a in a b a returns two hits at offsets 0 and 4. An empty pattern returns an empty list.
